crosschecks.finding: gespraech.berechtigung defaults to acceptEdits, is returned by gespraech_status, and the setter accepts acceptEdits, bypassPermissions, auto and dontAsk.
RealtimeSession receives cfg.berechtigung and _claude_taetigkeit forwards it to claude_frage; no cwd override is passed by this bridge.

claude_frage invokes claude -p with --permission-mode, hard --disallowedTools Bash and --append-system-prompt; the inspected command contains no explicit --settings and falls back to Path.home() as cwd when none is provided.
